# Copilot Instructions for examen_practica_is

## Repository Overview
This is a software engineering practice exam repository (examen de practica de ingenieria de software).

## General Guidelines

### Code Quality
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
- Follow the DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principle
- Use meaningful variable and function names
- Add comments for complex logic

### Testing
- Write tests for new functionality
- Ensure all tests pass before committing
- Maintain high test coverage

### Version Control
- Make small, focused commits with descriptive messages
- Keep commit history clean and meaningful
- Follow conventional commit message format when applicable

### Documentation
- Update documentation when making changes
- Keep README.md up to date
- Document public APIs and interfaces

## Best Practices
- Follow language-specific conventions and style guides
- Handle errors gracefully
- Consider security implications in all code changes
- Optimize for readability first, then performance
- Review your code before committing

## Contributing
- Review existing code to understand patterns and conventions
- Ask questions if requirements are unclear
- Test changes thoroughly before submitting
